q2_gaps: a lowercase descriptive adjective before a proper noun that is not a place ("the standard Linux operating system") — Names and casing gives only the place-specific sub-region route (mint a witness, predicate the adjective of it, contain it with LocatedIn), which has no analogue for a non-place named entity, so the modifier can only be flattened onto the name symbol
notes: The definite plural group, the narrow-scoped (Or ...) over the two Theme atoms inside one (And ...) fact, the capability (Can e) on a specific subject, the compound genus (Inheritance operating_system system), and the added per-member distribution rule at 1.0/0.9 all follow the instruction set. Keeping "operating system" out of the name symbol and stating the kind separately is exactly the Kestrel-River rule.
